⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: The electric dryer spins fine but produces zero heat, or refuses to start at all when you press the Push-to-Start button.

Verified technical root cause: Open heating coil inside the 5400W can-style heater element (causes 'runs with no heat') or blown white plastic thermal fuse on the blower housing (causes 'will not start').

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Unplug the dryer and remove the sheet-metal back panel using a 1/4-inch nut driver (no need to disassemble the drum!).
  2. If the dryer won't start at all, test the white plastic fuse WP3392519 on the blower chute for continuity.
  3. If the dryer spins cold, unhook the red wires from the lower right vertical heater canister 279838, remove the two 1/4-inch screws, slide out the broken coil canister, and slide in the new 279838 element.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (Dryer Runs But No Heat / Blown Thermal Fuse)

How long does it take to replace part 279838 on a Whirlpool or Amana dryer?
Because part 279838 is mounted right behind the rear metal service panel, you don't even have to open the front of the dryer—it takes under 15 minutes with a single 1/4-inch nut driver.
